title: Choose your TV browser design
question: Preview three home-screen directions; browser menu previews are in the interactive comparison.

options.label: Gallery
options.thesis: A modern gallery room with beautiful art and a calm search area.
options.viewport: Search and saved pages on the left; framed Van Gogh on the right; warm menu from the left.
options.risk: Brighter than the other options in a dark room.

options.label: Ambient
options.thesis: An expansive landscape with a search bar that feels at home on a TV.
options.viewport: Full-screen landscape, large search pill, favorites, recent tabs and a right-side browser menu.
options.risk: Closest to the familiar Google TV aesthetic.

options.label: Coast
options.thesis: A colorful, compact browser dashboard with a coastal backdrop.
options.viewport: Slim destination rail, panoramic photo, colored favorites and a wide lower menu tray.
